summary: PLAN_ID toolchain-workflow-repair; CLI requires repository-root and plan-dir, optional out; validates exactly one slice receipt for each W0-W6 under logs/tdd-adapter/toolchain-workflow-repair/<slice>/*/slice-receipt.json; receipt must be JSON with predicate slice-ready, status pass, empty failures and authorizes; missing, duplicate, unreadable, malformed, or non-current receipts produce slice-specific failures; emits schema toolchain-workflow-repair.terminal-result.v2 with predicate implementation-complete, pass only when no failures, otherwise fail; authorizes empty and lifecycle transition none; optional output directory is created and result written UTF-8 newline; exit code 0 on pass, 1 on fail
